access.create: admin or owning developer / team member
access.update: admin or owning developer / team member

fields.name: logo
fields.label: Logo
fields.description: Logo image URL — or upload a file in Media and paste its URL here.

fields.name: location
fields.label: Primary Location
fields.description: e.g. Colombo 03

fields.name: hide_from_site
fields.label: Hide from the public site
fields.description: For test or private accounts: leaves this developer off the Developers page, the sitemap and search, and its profile page returns not found. The dashboard is not affected.

fields.name: siteStats
fields.label: Company stats (as published on the company site)
fields.description: Shown as a stat row on the public developer page. Copy the wording the company itself prints, e.g. "100+". Leave blank for any stat the company does not publish.

fields.name: coDevelopers
fields.label: Co-Developers (external, not in system)
fields.description: Free-text credits for co-developers that don’t have a Developer record here — shown on the public builder page.

fields.name: imageUrl
fields.label: Image URL
fields.description: Image URL — or upload a file in Media and paste its URL here.

fields.name: url
fields.label: Learn More Link
fields.description: Optional — link to the award announcement/press release.

fields.name: lead_alerts
fields.label: Lead alerts
fields.description: Every new inquiry on one of your projects is emailed — and sent by WhatsApp once the WhatsApp Business API is connected — the moment it comes in, with the buyer’s details and one-tap reply links.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Alert email
fields.description: Leave blank to use the Contact Email above (or the linked account’s login email).

fields.name: cc
fields.label: CC on lead alerts
fields.description: Extra addresses that get a copy of every lead alert email (for example a sister brand's inbox). Never used in test mode.

fields.name: whatsapp
fields.label: Alert WhatsApp number
fields.description: International format, e.g. +94 77 123 4567. Leave blank to use the WhatsApp number under Social Links.

fields.name: response_stats
fields.label: Response time (auto)
fields.description: Earned, not entered: over the last 90 days, at least 5 leads old enough to judge and 80% of them answered (moved off "New") within 24 hours. Shows as a "Responds within 24 hours" badge on the profile and every listing. (Field names below keep their original "hour" wording — internal only, not user-facing.)

fields.label: Admin settings (set automatically from the subscription)

fields.name: plan
fields.label: Plan
fields.description: Set automatically from an active subscription. Decides how many listings can be featured.

fields.name: featuredUntil
fields.label: Featured Until
fields.description: When the plan ends (the subscription renewal date). After this, listings go back to Free until renewed.

fields.name: extra_featured_slots
fields.label: Extra Featured Slots (purchased)
fields.description: Extra featured spots bought on top of the plan.

fields.name: first_subscribed_at
fields.label: First Subscribed At
fields.description: Date of the first subscription ever. Never changes.

fields.name: is_founding_developer
fields.label: Founding Developer (40% off, first 10)
fields.description: Given automatically to the first 10 developers to subscribe. Permanent once earned.

fields.name: featuredProjectIds
fields.label: Featured Projects
fields.description: Which of your own projects use your plan's featured slots. Projects left unpicked stay on Free even while you have an active paid plan — pick up to your plan's limit (base slots + any extra slots purchased), shared with your land listings below.

fields.name: featuredLandIds
fields.label: Featured Land Listings
fields.description: Which of your own land listings use your plan's featured slots (shared with featuredProjectIds above).

fields.name: domain_verified
fields.label: Verified Developer
fields.description: Shows the "Verified Developer" badge. Set automatically when the company confirms an email on its own website domain; an admin can also switch it on or off by hand.

fields.name: extra_email_domains
fields.label: Approved extra email domains
fields.description: Admin only. Email domains (besides the website domain) accepted for Verified Developer, e.g. jkproperties.lk when the website is johnkeellsproperties.com.

fields.name: verification_status
fields.label: Verification Status
fields.description: Gates the "Developer approval" workflow — new self-registered developers start pending.

fields.name: user
fields.label: User
fields.description: The developer-role account that manages this company profile. Leave blank when pre-building a profile before the developer has an account — if they later sign up with this Contact Email, they auto-claim it (and everything created under it, including projects); otherwise set this manually once they exist.

fields.name: referenceLinks
fields.label: Links the owner shared
fields.description: Internal only. Where this listing's information came from: developer site, brochure PDF, video, map pin, third-party page.

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.description: What it is, e.g. "Brochure PDF", "Developer site", "Google Maps pin".

fields.name: note
fields.label: Note
fields.description: Optional: date shared, what to check there.

fields.name: contactLog
fields.label: Other contact (Instagram, WhatsApp, phone…)
fields.description: Internal only. A note for every time you reached this company outside email, for example an Instagram message asking them to register. Emails appear above by themselves.

fields.name: summary
fields.label: Summary
fields.description: What happened, e.g. "Asked them to register and verify".

fields.name: link
fields.label: Link
fields.description: Optional: link to the conversation or profile.

fields.name: seo
fields.label: Search engine & sharing
fields.description: What Google and social apps show for this page. Everything is optional — blank fields fall back to the page name and text.

fields.name: seoTitle
fields.label: SEO title
fields.description: The blue headline in Google. Aim for about 60 characters or fewer. Blank = the page name.

fields.name: seoDescription
fields.label: SEO description
fields.description: The grey text under it. Aim for 120–160 characters.

fields.name: ogImage
fields.label: Share image
fields.description: Picture shown when the page is shared. Image URL — or upload a file in Media and paste its URL here.

fields.name: canonicalUrl
fields.label: Canonical URL
fields.description: Only if this page should count as a copy of another address. Usually leave blank.

fields.name: noIndex
fields.label: Hide this page from search engines
